He wasn’t supposed to eat them - he was considered a bit of an oddity to do such a thing considering they lacked any real deeper flavor and hurt more than most other foods he could opt for. Yet, Mydei’s mind was more focused on the way he could feel one of Phainon’s hands leaving his face - trailing downwards and back to his abdomen to push on him again.

.. To force their eggs to spill out of Mydei, such a pleasurable thing and Mydei.. 

“Stop.. Pushing my stomach you’re making them spill out more!” Mydei couldn’t help the amount of fear that was creeping into his words - etched into them with a knife that seemed desperate to choke Mydei more and more as he felt a bit of despair over it. 

They would die, wouldn’t they?

All of the eggs leaving his vent.. They would die without him, wouldn’t they? And it was all his fault for failing them? How was he supposed to be okay with Phainon’s hand pushing on his stomach and forcing them to slide out of Mydei?

He couldn’t.. He couldn’t just be okay with that..

“Mn,” Phainon only mindlessly seemed to hum in amusement over his pleading, however, “I’ll just have to put more into you later, isn’t that fine? You’ll feel so good during that too!”

That.. That wasn’t the issue here, not as Mydei grit his teeth and felt his insides clenching - no longer for pleasure but feeling more than a little desperate to keep his eggs inside of him. Trying his best to tighten and keep them safe, all while he could feel his eyes burning still from his tears. 

Mydei could only try again while at his wits end, “Phainon.. Please, they’re my.. My babies..”

Whatever Mydei had said seemed to be enough for Phainon to actually pause - the pressure immediately subsiding on Mydei’s lower abdomen as that fish seemed busy in his own thoughts. It was enough to make Mydei blink at him, doing his best to make sure Phainon fully understood how pathetic he felt to beg for this.

And Phainon.. He only offered a little solemn smile as their eyes met. 

“.. Your babies? Ah.. I’m sorry Mydei..” Phainon’s voice was softer than before, smoother and more enticing as he moved to pull Mydei a little, “Come here..”

The oddest thing was how his insides felt so much emptier now - feeling those tentacles giving up on rampaging in his body to instead relax a little. Clearly obeying Phainon who now was letting Mydei rest, at least, he had to hope that was what Phainon was doing as he was now left substantially more empty with just eggs inside of him. 

“What.. Are you doing now?” Mydei found himself tiredly asking as tentacle after tentacle slowly wrapped around him instead once more - one after another that made Mydei feel like he was at risk of being squeezed to death at any time with this fish. And yet, Phainon only sweetly hummed as his hands pulled Mydei just a little bit closer to his chest. 

“I’m being possessive..” Phainon replied as if that actually answered anything at all and didn’t work to make Mydei feel more insane as eggs shifted inside of him as Phainon’s tentacles coiled around him slowly. 

Mydei couldn’t help but to sigh as Phainon didn’t continue explaining either, “.. And what does that mean?”

“I’m wrapping around my family so you can rest easily..” Phainon murmured softly, and that was enough to make Mydei’s mind blank over being called ‘family’ or well, maybe Phainon had just meant the eggs inside of Mydei. He did say so Mydei could rest after mentioning his family, and that was enough to make Mydei huff a little over it.

He didn’t need rest, he could tend to them just fine on his way back home..

Though, Mydei only watched as those tentacles continued to wrap around him one after another - seeming as if they were doing their best to be as gentle with his stomach and vent as possible as well, “.. How many tentacles do you even have?”

“Enough,” Phainon answered, making Mydei more than a little aware that Phainon had no clue about the answer to that question and was absolutely just saying some nonsense on the matter.

“How many is enough?”

“I’ve.. Never counted, really, but it’s enough,” Phainon admitted and sighed out, sounding like he was a bit defeated over the fact he had no idea about 

“Whatever number you thought it may be, subtract one,” Mydei mused however, still watching the way the tentacles were curling around him in such a needy way. As if they were trying their best to keep his eggs safe, though.. Mydei was pretty sure he was the most dangerous fish around fresh jellyfish eggs, anyway..?

“Hah.. Alright, you’re right,” Phainon laughed a little softly, all before he hummed just as sweetly, “You seem tired, Mydei.”

“It’s natural to be tired after breeding..” Mydei bit back without a second thought - shooting a glare at the fish who was leaning over him a little, staring at the way Phainon only tilted his head a bit innocently with those words. 

“Neither of us are supposed to breed like this, so I’m not sure if ‘natural’ is the right word for anything either of us do together..”

Mydei made a huffing noise at that - moving to free a hand with a bit of wonder that Phainon wasn’t stressing about keeping his hands bound. But regardless, Mydei jerked his hand upwards to grasp onto Phainon’s chin - finding himself smugly smiling over the gasped out noise Phainon had made over that as Mydei squeezed his cheeks a little with his fingers. Feeling Phainon’s form only oozing around his clawed fingers oddly. 

“Be quiet, Phainon,” Mydei growled as he stared upwards at that man - not shocked at all over the way Phainon stared right back at him with rather cute widened eyes. As if he hadn’t been expecting Mydei to touch him at all before he gave a laugh over that - tilting his head a little to rub into Mydei’s hand more to be petted almost. 

“You know! I think I’m a good balance to your life! You need someone willing to talk a lot and bring more to conversations to help how quiet you are!” Phainon happily argued, much too sweetly as Mydei watched the way that jellyfish rubbed against his webbed fingers - appearing much too giddy to have such a gentle touch on him as Mydei gave up completely on holding his chin. 

“.. I don’t talk to many other people,” Mydei confessed as he watched Phainon still happily rubbing into his hand for affection - eyes staring at the way Phainon was oddly so honest in his emotions.

“Good!”

.. Maybe too honest, Mydei had to admit as he heard that word entering his own head, watching the way Phainon only seemed to perk up more over that confession. 

He couldn’t help but feel a little confused over why that would earn such an odd reaction, though, “.. Good?” 

“I’m the only fish you need in your life, now! Well, me, and our couple of tens of thousands babies inside of you!” Phainon explained so very energetically, and Mydei could only find his mind trailing back to how.. Full he was. The way he could feel his eggs shifting inside of him when Phainon’s tentacles around him tightened or lessened.

As if Phainon himself was rubbing against his body to check and feel their children in there possessively, checking on them and making sure that Mydei was still nice and full of them.

.. Though a piece of Mydei had to assume Phainon would be more than a little excited to breed him again if they weren’t - and the worst part was how Mydei knew he himself would be just as eager to be bred by that jellyfish. 

“.. Gee, how wonderful,” Mydei huffed sarcastically as he moved to look at the swell just under his vent that had closed up now - no longer being sexually teased or roused for breeding to where it had nicely shut to protect their eggs and keep them inside of Mydei.

.. Even if Mydei didn’t think his body was doing that on purpose at all, really, considering the fact neither one of them were even supposed to breed like this at all. Mydei should be laying eggs if anything, and then a male would fertilise them - and instead he had an allegedly asexual reproducing jellyfish forcing him to keep his eggs safe after Phainon himself had fertilised them as well.

How were these supposed to hatch, anyway? Would he just have little jellyfish escaping his vent? 

.. Weird. 

But Phainon didn’t seem to care about how weird anything was, only tightening his tentacles a little to keep Mydei nice and close to him as he laughed again, “Isn’t it?! I’m so excited!”

That was enough to make Mydei slowly look back up at Phainon who was keeping Mydei nice and close to his chest. Staring at the way that jellyfish seemed so genuinely happy in this situation that.. It was bizarre to Mydei, “Are you not going to let go of me?”

Phainon didn’t miss a second before giving Mydei a stunned look right back - his eyes blown wide as he seemed to process that question, “.. Why would I do that?”

For once, Phainon’s voice sounded more clipped and jagged, as if he was even hurt by the mere idea of letting go of Mydei and not having his tentacles rubbing on every part of the clownfish. It was insanity to consider, but for some reason Mydei did think that it was endearing, probably not the reason, but sweet nonetheless. 

“So.. I may leave? Unless you still intend on killing me,” Mydei offered with confusion lacing his words - it didn’t make much sense to breed him full of his eggs only to kill and eat Mydei after, but maybe that was just what his species of jellyfish did..? Mydei didn’t know. 

“‘Still’ intend? I never intended on that even once..” Phainon muttered a bit coldly all while his own wrist shot out to grab Mydei’s hand - gripping onto him with a level of strength and possession that Mydei didn’t quite understand at all, “Why would you leave me?”

.. Why?

Wasn’t that obvious?

They weren’t the same species, and Mydei wasn’t exactly.. He probably was not popular with other jellyfish to where it would be fine for him to be around Phainon. 

“.. I will make sure your children hatch when I leave here, but I cannot stay around your fellow jellyfish, Phainon. I am t-”

Mydei found himself being cut off at that - interrupted completely as a tentacle slapped against his mouth. Not entering it but instead pressing the side against Mydei’s mouth, enough to muffle him as it silenced his ability to speak all while Mydei found himself snarling a little over it. Half his mind said to bite down on the tentacle barely in his mouth - but the saner part of him knew Phainon would just.. Enjoy that too much, really. 

“I’ll feed you my fellow jellyfish myself if it means I get to keep you around, my beloved,” Phainon’s voice was softer now, much too sweet as Mydei felt Phainon’s fingers slowly molding around his own to hold his hand so gently. Coiling their bodies together as much as he could almost desperately all while Mydei found himself still gagged and staring at that needy jellyfish. 

Though, the gagging didn’t last long at all, apparently it was just being used to not allow Mydei to finish his words about the reasons why he couldn’t stay here as it slid out of his mouth slowly. Instead drooping down to rest on his neck and working to send a chill down his spine over how oddly slimy and cold Phainon felt against him at times. 

“.. Then where are you taking me?” Mydei found himself asking over the offer of Phainon feeding him fellow jellyfish - somewhat feeling.. Endeared and enamored over the offer, as if this fish was more than willing to sacrifice things for him already in their relationship. 

And for some reason, Mydei couldn’t find it in himself to deny him - not anymore. Not when Phainon seemed to truly mean his words and looked much more pathetic or upset when Mydei so much as tried to reason with him.

But there was no way to reason with either of them now, was there? They had already gone against their actual biology with reproduction in general, did it matter anymore? 

“Just.. Wherever I go, isn’t that fine? I want to stay together with you,” Phainon whined a little out - sounding more than just needy to Mydei’s ears as he looked at the way Phainon only appeared to be pleading silently with his eyes as well, “As I said.. That’s why I’m so coiled around you.. Let’s just ride the currents together.”

The worst part of those words as Phainon spoke them was how.. That sounded fine to Mydei.

For some reason, the idea of going wherever with Phainon sounded more than fine as he found himself scoffing a little over how truly charming this annoying jellyfish was to him. 

“.. If you say something cheesy about the ‘currents of life’ I will eat another of your tentacles again,” Mydei growled out though, unable to help himself to squeezing his own hand against Phainon’s - delighting almost in the way Phainon merely squeezed right back in response to his showing of affection towards Mydei, who he considered his own family now. 

“Mydei, please do not threaten me with a good time, I’m vulnerable.”
